# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man with a round face that is devoid of expression. He is frequently described as endlessly grinning or smirking.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Barney is foolish, kindly, extremely hard-working, and lacks negative vices. He possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Due to his immense bashfulness and timidity, he struggles to express his feelings or propose directly.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Traits

- overweight  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- emotionless face  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- hard-working  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- bashful  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- farming  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- to marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Barney harbored a vast admiration for Nell Harcourt and drove her in his buggy to a hotel concert at Pale Sands, feeling immense pride in traveling beside her. Because his father bestowed the upper farm upon him, he sought to take a bride and desired to make Nell his wife. Too bashful to ask her himself, he repeatedly harassed his sister Odette until she agreed to propose to Nell on his behalf. Through Odette, he offered to marry Nell before spring planting or wait until her college education was finished, but Nell firmly rejected the proposal.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- brother of Odette Pullen  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- received the upper farm in his own name from his father  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Relationships

### Odette Pullen

- Sibling of — Barney's sister who relays his marriage proposal to Nell  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

### Nell

- Romantic with — Barney is in love with Nell and unsuccessfully proposes marriage to her through his sister  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016)</sub>
